trigger_condition: managedNames is empty but gateway keys (inferenceProvider/BaseUrl/ApiKey/AuthScheme) were still written
guard_snippet: if (managedNames.length === 0) { still check existsSync(configPath) && INFERENCE_KEYS present before short-circuiting }
potential_consequence: disconnect --claude-desktop reports nothing-to-disconnect while API key/gateway config stays on disk

trigger_condition: writeDesktopConfig runs with orgFetchSucceeded=false (catalog fetch failed) on the very first connect
guard_snippet: write/refresh the marker state even on a failed org fetch, or track gateway-key presence independently of managedNames
potential_consequence: marker file never created; every later removeDesktopConfig call silently no-ops even though gateway config was written

trigger_condition: readProviders/writeAtomically throws for the Insiders location after the stable location already succeeded
guard_snippet: wrap each loop iteration's write in try/catch, accumulate per-location errors, and still return removed:true for the location that succeeded
potential_consequence: one location is already fixed on disk but the whole call throws, reporting total failure and losing that it partially succeeded

trigger_condition: readSettings/writeAtomically throws for the Insiders location after stable already succeeded
guard_snippet: catch per-iteration errors inside the insiders/stable loop instead of letting them propagate past a prior success
potential_consequence: same partial-completion-reported-as-full-failure gap as vscode.ts; stable edit already on disk is not reflected in the result

trigger_condition: process.platform is neither darwin/win32/linux, so getVsCodeProductDir throws ConfigurationError for both iterations
guard_snippet: distinguish 'edition not installed' from 'platform unsupported' instead of catching both as continue
potential_consequence: unsupported-platform error is swallowed and misreported to the user as 'nothing to disconnect'
